description: Commission of Elections - Notifying that the Registers of Elector's for the 22 Electoral Districts been certified and open for Inspection
reasoning: This gazette content pertains specifically to electoral processes, specifically the revision of electoral registers for the Colombo and Gampaha electoral districts.
